School Retrofit Volunteer in Lembang

Aster Japan-ITB Collaboration, final year at ITB

Aster supplied Aster Power Coating, a Fiber Reinforced Polymer (FRP), to repair the cracking walls of a school in Lembang. The team also raised extra funds to renovate the rest of the school, including its toilets and classrooms.

  • Weekly site visits: The committee, including Joanna, went to the school every week during the retrofit.
  • Weekly class: One hour each week teaching students about earthquakes, natural disasters, and how to act.
  • Impact: The students answered with thank-you letters about their safer, cleaner school.
